cves.d: A flaw was found in libsoup, a library used by applications to send network requests. This vulnerability occurs because libsoup does not properly validate hostnames, allowing special characters to be injected into HTTP headers. A remote attacker could exploit this to perform HTTP smuggling, where they can send hidden, malicious requests alongside legitimate ones. In certain situations, this could lead to Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), enabling an attacker to force the server to make unauthorized requests to other internal or external systems. The impact is low, as SoupServer is not actually used in internet infrastructure.

A flaw was found in libsoup. A remote attacker, by controlling the method parameter of the `soup_message_new()` function, could inject arbitrary headers and additional request data. This vulnerability, known as CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) injection, occurs because the method value is not properly escaped during request line construction, potentially leading to HTTP request injection.

An invalid memory release in the MongoDB PHP Driver extension occurs when certain string-typed options or type-mapping settings are given non-string values. A party who can run PHP code in a process that loads the extension may corrupt process memory. This can lead to reading or changing process memory, running commands as the PHP process user, or crashing the process.

A cleartext transmission of sensitive information vulnerability in the ADM Notifications allows network eavesdroppers on the outbound network path to obtain Clickatell service credentials via the SMS. When executing an SMS test for Clickatell Communicator Central, the backend function Send_Test_SMS embeds the sensitive contents directly into an unencrypted HTTP request URL. An observer on the NAS network egress path can capture the plain text credentials and message payload since the initial request is transmitted without TLS protection or secret redaction.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

The fix for CVE-2026-45756 lowers pcre.backtrack_limit to 10000 around each preg_match() call of the match() and search() filter functions. That limit applies to one starting position, not to one call. PCRE resets its counter at every position it tries a match from. So an unanchored pattern that stays just under the limit is paid once per byte of the subject. Each call also starts from a fresh limit, so chaining clauses in one filter multiplies the work.

Two other paths made the cost of a query grow faster than its size, without any regular expression:
- The filter evaluator scanned the whole expression for logical operators once per node. Its cost grew with the square of the number of chained clauses.
- Queries starting with $ inside a filter, like @.x == $.limit or length($.items), were evaluated again for every node the filter visits.

An application that evaluates an attacker-influenced JSONPath expression can therefore still be made to hold a PHP worker. A document of 2 MB and a query of 2.5 KB take 3.5 minutes of CPU.

JsonCrawler::find() now bounds the total regex work of one call, and throws an exception when that budget is exhausted. Filter expressions are parsed once per query, and absolute queries inside filters are evaluated once per query.

A flaw was found in the file-gif-load plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted JIF image file, a 32-bit integer overflow occurs during the pixel buffer size calculation, while the zlib output limit is computed separately without wrapping. This leads to an undersized heap allocation, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow when the compressed image data is decompressed. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

A path traversal vulnerability in the File Explorer share-link folder-listing endpoint allows a remote attacker with a folder-scoped share link to list directory contents outside the shared folder, including other Samba shares readable by the link creator, because path validation occurs before path canonicalization.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A path traversal vulnerability in the File Explorer share-link upload component allows a remote attacker with a folder-scoped upload share link to upload or overwrite files in the shared folder's immediate parent directory due to missing trailing validation prior to path canonicalization.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A flaw was found in libssh. Logic errors in automatic certificate-based public key authentication can cause libssh clients to loop indefinitely when configured certificates are missing or repeatedly rejected by a server, leading to denial of service.

A flaw was found in libssh. During server-side GSSAPI key exchange, a client-supplied Curve25519 public key shorter than the expected length is copied without proper length validation, leading to an out-of-bounds heap read. This could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to disclose small amounts of server memory.

The MongoDB Rust driver's connection-string parser can include database password text and authentication property values in the error messages it returns when a connection string is malformed. The optional error-redaction feature does not fully remove this text. A party with read access to the application's logs or error output may obtain part or all of a database credential.

Reliance on an untrusted source of the client address in the WebSocket listener of the NetBird relay server (relay/server/listener/ws) in NetBird versions 0.31.1 through 0.74.7 allows an attacker with an enrolled peer to spoof the source address of their relay connection. The listener used the values of the X-Real-Ip and X-Real-Port request headers as the remote address of the connection unconditionally, without checking that the request came from a trusted upstream proxy. A WebSocket client that sends both headers makes the relay record and use an arbitrary address for its connection, including in the relay connection log, so a client can hide its real address or attribute its connection to another host. Only the relay server is affected; the NetBird client, including the Android and iOS apps, does not run the relay listener. The issue is fixed in version 0.75.0, which honours these headers only for requests whose direct connection address is in a configured set of trusted proxies and ignores them by default.

Binding to an unrestricted IP address in the netstack SOCKS5 proxy of the NetBird client (client/iface/netstack) in NetBird versions before 0.74.7 allows an unauthenticated attacker on the same network as the client to relay traffic through the client into its NetBird overlay network. When the client runs in netstack mode (NB_USE_NETSTACK_MODE=true), it starts a SOCKS5 proxy, without authentication, that is meant to bridge applications on the local host into the userspace WireGuard stack. The listener was bound to 0.0.0.0 instead of the loopback address, so any host that can reach the proxy port (1080 by default) can connect and reach peers and internal resources with the network position of the affected client. Netstack mode is not enabled by default. The issue is fixed in version 0.74.7, which binds the proxy to 127.0.0.1 by default.

The MongoDB C Driver does not confirm that the party signing a supplied certificate revocation status response is authorized to answer for the certificate being checked. An unauthenticated party that operates the TLS endpoint a client connects to can therefore have a withdrawn certificate accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of the application's database traffic and in the loss of the revocation decision.
glib-networking's OpenSSL backend fails to properly check the return value of memory allocation routines. An out of memory condition could potentially result in writing to an invalid memory location.
glib-networking's OpenSSL backend fails to properly check the return value of a call to BIO_write(), resulting in an out of bounds read.

A flaw was found in the GIF parser of GdkPixbuf’s LZW decoder. When an invalid symbol is encountered during decompression, the decoder sets the reported output size to the full buffer length rather than the actual number of written bytes. This logic error results in uninitialized sections of the buffer being included in the output, potentially leaking arbitrary memory contents in the processed image.

A vulnerability has been identified in the libarchive library. This flaw can be triggered when file streams are piped into bsdtar, potentially allowing for reading past the end of the file. This out-of-bounds read can lead to unintended consequences, including unpredictable program behavior, memory corruption, or a denial-of-service condition.

An incorrect authorization weakness in the embedded relation handling of the Laravel MongoDB library may allow a user with basic application privileges to alter records belonging to other users. After an embedded relation is pre-loaded, a routine write on that record is issued without the constraint that limits it to the record the user is permitted to change. This may result in unintended modification or loss of stored data for other users of the same application.

An argument injection vulnerability exists in the settings/vpn.cgi endpoint in the ADM. When processing a WireGuard profile, the internal command parser removes quotes and performs a quote-agnostic scan on arguments without properly sanitizing redirection operators. An authenticated administrator can supply a crafted parameter to cause the execution helper to open and truncate arbitrary files on the filesystem with root privileges, resulting in an arbitrary file truncation and denial-of-service (DoS) condition.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A query builder component in a MongoDB integration library for a PHP web framework does not run the query-modification callbacks that an application registers with the framework before sending read, update, and delete operations to the database. As a result, a filter that an application relies on to limit which records a request may touch can be omitted silently. A user with basic application privileges may be able to read or change records that the application intended to keep out of reach.

A protection mechanism failure in the userspace firewall of the NetBird client (client/firewall/uspfilter) in NetBird versions 0.55.0 through 0.74.6 allows an attacker who controls an enrolled peer to bypass the access control rules of another peer by sending IP-fragmented packets. The packet filter returned an allow verdict for any IPv4 fragment, and for any IPv6 packet carrying a Fragment extension header, before evaluating the ACL rules. This applied to the leading fragment as well as to continuation fragments, so no part of a fragmented datagram was filtered and ports denied by policy could be reached. The userspace filter is the packet filter wherever the client does not program the kernel firewall, which includes the Android and iOS apps. The issue is fixed in version 0.74.7, in the Android app from version 0.6.0 and in the iOS app from version 0.3.3, which evaluate fragments against the same ACL rules as unfragmented packets.

Cross Site Scripting in Markdown renderer in Apache JSPWIKI 2.4 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows attacker to bypass html encoding techniques to potentially render raw html or javascript in the browser.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

Vulnerability involving the exposure of sensitive information in the ver_usuarios endpoint. The JSON response includes data that is not required for the query and which should remain restricted, such as Argon2id password hashes, TOTP secrets, internal configuration flags, email addresses, telephone numbers and dates of last access. An authenticated user querying this resource can access this confidential information, which is sent directly to the web client.
The log viewer of Zoraxy admin panel fails to neutralize the output properly, that may cause an arbitrary script to be executed on the administrator's browser.
ACME challenge routing logic of Zoraxy fails to validate request URIs properly, that allows an attacker to send an arbitrary request to a service on the internal network.

Error-based SQL injection vulnerability in the text parameter of the ver_usuarios endpoint. The SQL query is constructed from user-controlled data without proper validation or parameterisation. An authenticated user could submit a specially crafted input that triggers visible SQL errors in the response, including SQLSTATE[42S22] messages and references to columns in the query.
Accessible without authentication via /user/resetPasswordFlagTest, forcing a password change prompt on the next admin login.
Zoraxy provided by Zoraxy Project does not add HttpOnly attribute to session cookies that allows an attacker to retrieve session cookies via a script executed on the browser.
Admin password stored in plaintext at /data/data/com.acer.android.m3.webserver/shared_prefs/userInfo.xml, allowing any app with root or file access to read credentials directly.

Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in İdeal Data Finansal Teknolojiler A.Ş. IDeal WEB allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs.

This issue affects iDeal WEB: before v1.82.
After authentication, /user/getNetworkStatus discloses SIM phone number, cell tower ID (enabling geolocation), and network type.

Application Performance Management 9.60 patch versions before IP4 are affected. This issue seems to be present throughout the application, as several endpoints or functionalities that are restricted to Admin users can be directly accessed by Regular users. The authorization method of the application can be bypassed allowing users to perform unauthorized actions to their role. The application supports different levels of access. The application performs authorization checks to keep users from accessing functionality outside of their role such as create, verify, and/or repair. 




This authorization method can be bypassed. During VA testing, it was found that under the User Reports inside the Applications menu, it is possible to  create links and different reports. However, the creation of custom links, Excel reports, and service reports are restricted to admin users. Hence, it is possible for regular users with the least privileges to directly access these 

pages and the application allows them to further use these restricted functionalities.

System service 'antaiuiserver' exposes transaction 14 (sendMyATCmd) & 4, allowing ANY app on device to send arbitrary AT commands to modem without permissions (no READ_PHONE_STATE, SEND_SMS). Enables reading IMEI, IMSI, ICCID, and managing SMS.

An externally-controlled format string vulnerability exists in the authenticated upload_wireguard action of settings/vpnupload.cgi in the ADM. The CGI takes an attacker-controlled WireGuard profile name, inserts it into a JSON object, serializes it, and passes the resulting formatted string directly to printf as the format argument without validation or escaping. An authenticated remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending format string specifiers, or leverage variadic read/write primitives within the non-PIE, non-Canary root CGI to potentially achieve arbitrary remote code execution with root privileges.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

In Application Performance Management versions before 9.60 IP4, The application is vulnerable to cross-site scripting wherein the application does not properly validate the input parameters, allowing scripts to be injected and then executed in the context of a user’s browser. This can lead to the attacker stealing sensitive information, impersonating users, or performing actions on their behalf.  Also, the application may also be vulnerable to the below attacks:

• Link Injection – This occurs when an attacker inserts a malicious link into a webpage, often in a way that makes it appear legitimate. When user clicks on the link, they may be directed to a harmful website or prompted to download malicious files.



• Frame Injection – This attack involved embedding a webpage within an invisible frame on another site, User interacts with what appears to be a legitimate site, but their actions are performed on the malicious page, potentially leading to unintended actions or data theft.

An externally controlled format string vulnerability in the Snapshot CGI components of ADM allows an authenticated administrator to cause repeatable premature termination of affected privileged CGI requests by supplying crafted input.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

Directory traversal vulnerability in the custom-homepage asset endpoint (/__api__/custom/home/) 
allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files readable by the Package Manager service account via a filesystem path appended to the request URI in Posit Software, PBC Posit Package Manager: 





  *  before 2025.09.6,
  *  2025.12.x before 2025.12.4
  *  2026.04.x before 2026.04.4
  *  2026.05.x before 2026.05.2
  *  2026.06.x before 2026.06.2
  *  2026.08.x before 2026.08.2
  *  2026.09.x before 2026.09.2
  *  2026.10.x before 2026.10.2
  *  2026.11.x before 2026.11.2








NOTE: In the default configuration, where Server.LandingPage is unset, request paths are resolved from the filesystem root, so no directory-traversal sequences are required and exploitation is not detected by scanners that test only for ../ sequences.

An External Control of File Name or Path (Argument Injection) vulnerability in the settings/notification.cgi component of ADM allows authenticated remote administrators to create or truncate arbitrary files with root privileges via crafted request parameters. An authenticated administrator can truncate arbitrary critical files across the root filesystem, leading to system failure or Denial of Service (DoS).
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A polymorphic relationship query helper in the MongoDB Eloquent integration for Laravel resolves a record's type identifier inconsistently between the code that stores a relationship link and the code that searches for one. An application that relies on a relationship-absence query to restrict which records a request may see or change can therefore have that restriction silently fail, allowing a user with basic application privileges to read and to modify or remove records the restriction was meant to cover.

A vulnerability has been identified in the libarchive library. This flaw involves an 'off-by-one' miscalculation when handling prefixes and suffixes for file names. This can lead to a 1-byte write overflow. While seemingly small, such an overflow can corrupt adjacent memory, leading to unpredictable program behavior, crashes, or in specific circumstances, could be leveraged as a building block for more sophisticated exploitation. This bug affects libarchive versions prior to 3.8.0.

A vulnerability has been identified in the libarchive library. This flaw involves an integer overflow that can be triggered when processing a Web Archive (WARC) file that claims to have more than INT64_MAX - 4 content bytes. An attacker could craft a malicious WARC archive to induce this overflow, potentially leading to unpredictable program behavior, memory corruption, or a denial-of-service condition within applications that process such archives using libarchive. This bug affects libarchive versions prior to 3.8.0.

A vulnerability has been identified in the libarchive library. This flaw can lead to a heap buffer over-read due to the size of a filter block potentially exceeding the Lempel-Ziv-Storer-Schieber (LZSS) window. This means the library may attempt to read beyond the allocated memory buffer, which can result in unpredictable program behavior, crashes (denial of service), or the disclosure of sensitive information from adjacent memory regions.

Insert Pages plugin for WordPress (insert-pages) before 3.11.6 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the insert_pages_handle_shortcode_insert() function that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to read draft, pending, scheduled, and private posts they do not own. Attackers can reference sequential post IDs in the [insert page] shortcode to render the full content, title, excerpt, and metadata of unpublished posts, since the function checks a generic read capability instead of enforcing the read_post meta capability tied to post author and status.

ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig is vulnerable to remote command injection via HTTP request. Due to the lack of input sanitization, a privileged attacker can inject shell metacharacters in the server parameter, resulting in arbitrary command execution as the root user on the operating system.


This issue was fixed in version 1.5.14.

SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by denial-of-service 
vulnerability that may allow users with privileged access 
to cause too much memory usage, causing the server to 
reject new connections. A specific configuration is 
required, and an SMTP server must be set up.

Improper neutralization of section delimiters in job files read by the Checkmk agents for Linux, AIX, Solaris, FreeBSD and OpenWrt in Checkmk <2.5.0p15, <2.4.0p38, <2.3.0p51 and 2.2.0 (EOL) allows a local user for whom mk-job job monitoring has been set up to inject arbitrary agent sections and piggyback data into the agent output, spoofing monitoring data of the monitored host and of other hosts, or hiding and impersonating the jobs of other users.

HortusFox is a self-hosted web application for collaborative plant management. Prior to 6.2, the toggle_boolean_value() handler in app/controller/admin.php passes the name parameter of the /admin/environment/boolean/toggle route in app/config/routes.php to AppModel::updateSingle() in app/models/AppModel.php, which concatenates the parameter into the SQL UPDATE identifier position without validation. An unauthenticated attacker can induce a signed-in administrator to open a crafted link, causing SQL injection that permits expressions and subqueries to read database contents, including an administrator password hash, or modify settings to enable passwordless administrator access. The hash alone does not permit direct login. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.

A flaw was found in rsyslog. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can trigger a stack-based buffer overflow by sending a malformed log message containing an embedded IPv4-in-IPv6 address to an instance configured with the mmanon anonymization module. This flaw causes the logging service to crash, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

Missing authorization in the REST API endpoint for updating the discovery phase of a single service in Checkmk <2.5.0p14, <2.4.0p37, <2.3.0p51 and 2.2.0 (EOL) allows an authenticated user whose role holds the four "Service discovery" permissions but lacks "Make changes, perform actions" or "Manage services" to move, disable or remove services on hosts the user can read.

SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be vulnerable to an 
unauthenticated HTTP response header injection 
vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate a 
victim's browser session.

In the `setup-osc` GitHub Action of Eclipse Apoapsis, from commit 4e9eaff up to, but not including, commit 03efc4c, the ORT Server version returned by the `/api/v1/versions` endpoint is inserted into a shell script via a GitHub Actions expression without validation. An attacker who controls the responses of the configured ORT Server, for example by compromising the server, can execute arbitrary commands on the GitHub Actions runner and access the secrets available to the calling workflow.



The issue is fixed in commit 03efc4c, which only accepts version strings consisting of alphanumeric characters, `.`, `+`, and `-`.

Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getDeploymentFrequency, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraApiAction#doExport, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraApiAction#doTrends, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraApiAction#doOverview, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.
A missing permission check in Jenkins Spira Importer Plugin 4.0.0 and earlier allows attackers with Overall/Read permission to have Jenkins connect to an attacker-specified URL.

Jenkins Subversion Plugin 1327.vc36e0019a_653 and earlier does not restrict URLs to HTTP or HTTPS schemes in the Sventon2 repository browser, allowing attackers with Item/Configure permission to determine the existence of paths on the Jenkins controller file system.

Jenkins Subversion Plugin 1327.vc36e0019a_653 and earlier does not restrict URLs to HTTP or HTTPS schemes in the Sventon repository browser, allowing attackers with Item/Configure permission to determine the existence of paths on the Jenkins controller file system.

A flaw was found in SSSD. The sss_nss_protocol_fill_initgr() function in the NSS responder pre-allocates reply space for all group entries but does not shrink the packet when groups are skipped, causing uninitialized heap bytes to be transmitted to the client. A local attacker can exploit this to disclose cached directory data and heap layout information from the sssd_nss process.

Missing authorization in the page behind the "Changes" slideout of the main menu in Checkmk versions 2.5.0 before 2.5.0p20 allows any authenticated user, including users with the built-in "Guest user" role, to read the text, author and time of all pending changes and the version, online status, login status and last activation result of all sites.

A data-query neutralization weakness in the query builder of the MongoDB integration for a PHP web framework allows values supplied to certain bulk counter-update helpers to be interpreted by the database as query expressions rather than stored as plain text. An application that passes externally supplied data into these helpers may write unintended values into stored documents and may result in unintended disclosure of other data held on the same document. No credentials are required of the party supplying the value.

In Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server versions 0.1.0 to 0.83.0, the file-based configuration providers do not restrict resolved file paths to the configured directory. An authenticated user who is allowed to trigger an ORT run for a single repository can use `../` sequences or absolute paths in `reporter-template://` references of the reporter job configuration to make the reporter worker read arbitrary files and include them in the generated reports. This discloses files such as environment variables, mounted secrets, and configuration files that contain credentials shared across all tenants of the server.



The issue is fixed in Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server 0.84.0.

SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an out-of-bounds 
memory read that could allow an attacker to disclose 
data from server memory.

In Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper versions 0.1.0 to 0.2.0, as shipped with Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server versions 0.65.0 to 0.83.0, the Git credential helper selects stored credentials by re-parsing the requested URL with a regular expression that can be confused by `:` and `@` characters in the URL path. An attacker who can make an ORT Server worker fetch a crafted Git URL, for example through a submodule of a repository that is analyzed, can obtain credentials stored for a different host, such as `github.com`, which Git then sends to the attacker-controlled server.



The issue is fixed in Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper 0.2.1 and Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server 0.84.0.
vp: eclipse apoapsis ort server credential helper

cves.d: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability in ssl_config.properties. An unauthenticated local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to credential exposure.
vp: virtual storage integrator for vmware vsphere web client

cves.d: A race condition during docker cp mount setup in Docker Engine allows a malicious container to leave a read-only bind mount writable while an archive is extracted into the container. When copying files into a container, the daemon bind-mounts the container's volumes into a temporary view and applies the read-only flags afterwards, through a path inside the container's filesystem. A process in the container can change that path in between, so the flags are applied to a different mount and the intended bind mount stays writable for the duration of the copy.

Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.0.0 until 3.1.13, peer certificates were parsed and their RSA public keys were passed to handshake signature and certificate-chain verification without an explicit modulus-size limit. A remote peer can provide a certificate with an unusually large attacker-chosen RSA modulus and an invalid signature; no corresponding private key or valid handshake signature is required to trigger the expensive operation. An RSA verification path must execute. A local ECDSA certificate does not prevent the peer from presenting an RSA certificate, and WebRTC deployments can be affected. Repeated or concurrent malicious handshakes can consume substantial CPU resources, delay legitimate connections, and reduce service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. Attackers can craft a glTF or GLB file whose bufferView byteOffset or byteLength exceeds its buffer, disclosing heap memory through embedded texture data or crashing the process.

The fix for CVE-2026-61801 added file type and size checks when parsing user and group files in github.com/moby/sys/user, but did not apply them consistently across all parsing and lookup functions. ParsePasswdFile, ParsePasswdFileFilter, GetAdditionalGroupsPath, ParseSubIDFile, ParseSubIDFileFilter, ParseIDMapFile, ParseIDMapFileFilter, LookupUser, LookupUid, LookupGroup and LookupGid could still read large or unbounded files. An attacker who controls the contents of a user or group file processed by an affected application, such as /etc/passwd or /etc/group from a container image, can cause excessive memory or CPU consumption, resulting in a denial of service. Exploitation depends on how the consuming application uses the affected functions. Fixed in v0.5.1 by enforcing the 10 MiB read limit in all affected functions. Docker Engine 29.10.1 includes the fix.

GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SDP_ParseAttribute that allows attackers to cause unbounded memory growth via a NUL byte in an a=fmtp line. Attackers can supply a crafted .sdp file or malicious RTSP DESCRIBE response to hang gf_sdp_info_parse and exhaust memory, causing denial of service.

A vulnerability in the MongoDB integration package for the Laravel framework allows an unauthorized user to bypass mass assignment attribute protections. When an application uses attribute deny-lists to guard sensitive model fields, specially crafted request payloads containing database operator keys can circumvent these protections. An unauthorized user with network access to an affected application endpoint can modify guarded attributes, potentially leading to privilege escalation within the application

C-More EA9 Programming Software V6.80 does not adequately validate data read from a project file before using it in heap memory operations. A crafted file causes a heap buffer overrun during file open, resulting in heap corruption and instability within the application. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by convincing a user to open a malicious project file delivered through common distribution channels such as email, file sharing, or removable media.

Spug before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator users to read per-host SSH private keys through the GET /api/host/ endpoint. Users granted a host can read the cleartext pkey field returned by Host.to_view and log in directly over SSH, bypassing Spug's permissions and audit trail even after revocation.

Deserialization of untrusted data in the relay server handshake of NetBird versions 0.29.0 through 0.74.7 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to reach the Go encoding/gob decoder with attacker-supplied bytes before any credential is checked, which can lead to denial of service of the relay server. The deprecated Hello handshake message was still accepted before authentication and its token was decoded with gob.NewDecoder (shared/relay/auth/hmac) before the HMAC signature was verified. The handshake buffer limits the input to 212 bytes and the pre-authentication phase to 10 seconds, so there is no impact on confidentiality or integrity and the impact on availability depends on a separate weakness in the gob decoder of the Go toolchain used to build the relay server, such as CVE-2024-34156. The Auth handshake, used by clients since version 0.29.1, does not use gob. The issue is fixed in version 0.75.0, which removes the Hello handshake and the gob-based token decoding.

An improper handling of repeated fields in encryption key documents in the MongoDB encryption support library may allow memory to be retained without release. A party able to write to the key storage collection, or a database endpoint returning such a document, may cause the memory use of the calling application process to grow for each document parsed, which may reduce performance of that process.

Mercur @mercurjs/core before 2.3.2 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated vendors to access other sellers by substituting the :id path parameter. Attackers can read payment and tax details, overwrite profiles and addresses, and invite, remove, or re-role team members to take over another vendor's store.

EpicStaff 1.2.0 before 1.3.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DocumentViewSet download and copy endpoints that allows authenticated users to access other organizations' documents. Attackers holding Knowledge Sources permissions in one organization can enumerate sequential document IDs to download or copy foreign documents, or insert documents into another organization's collection.

MongoDB C Driver contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the credential-selection logic used by its AWS authentication mechanism. A process-wide credential cache can take precedence over the credentials supplied for an individual connection, so a connection configured with one set of credentials may instead be authenticated under an identity cached earlier in the same process. A party able to cause the application process to open an additional connection may thereby obtain unintended privileges.

Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by a reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into a web page, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a maliciously crafted URL or interact with a compromised web page. Scope is changed.

A NULL pointer dereference and invalid memory release in the server discovery component of the MongoDB C Driver may allow an unauthenticated party that controls a server endpoint, or that can alter unencrypted network traffic, to cause a client application to terminate by sending a crafted discovery response.

Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.67 to 0.11.2, organization and team billing-manager roles intended only for spend management are treated as ordinary members across workflow, run, library, and marketplace routes. Although the role matrix in autogpt_platform/autogpt_libs/autogpt_libs/auth/permissions.py withholds run access and workflow creation, those routes do not enforce the matrix and their underlying membership lookups ignore the caller's role. As a result, a team billing manager can read team workflows and other members' runs (including inputs, outputs, and per-node data), while an organization billing manager can view shared workflows and runs and create workflows and marketplace listings; neither can modify or delete other members' workflows. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.3.
Dell PowerStore contains a weak password-storage vulnerability that could allow an attacker with access to the credential store to recover user passwords by offline brute force.

A flaw was found in libsoup. The chunked transfer encoding parser uses a permissive parsing function for chunk sizes that silently accepts inputs violating RFC 9112, including leading whitespace, plus sign prefixes, and trailing invalid characters. When libsoup operates behind a strict frontend proxy, this parsing differential can be exploited to smuggle HTTP requests.

Adobe Experience Manager is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. An attacker with high privileges could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized read and write access. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.
vp: adobe experience manager as a cloud service

cves.d: Canvas 7.0.0 before 7.2.11 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Contributors to inject scripts by exploiting a libxml2 parser differential in PostBody::clean(). Attackers can publish posts with slash-separated event handler attributes rendered unescaped in show.blade.php, hijacking Editor or Admin sessions to escalate their role to Admin.

browser-use before 1.0.0 contains a URL parser differential vulnerability in SecurityWatchdog that allows attackers to bypass allowed_domains, prohibited_domains, and block_ip_addresses checks by crafting a URL with a backslash before the allowed host, exploiting the mismatch between urllib.parse hostname extraction and Chromium's WHATWG-style URL parsing. Attackers can influence an LLM-controlled navigate action, such as through prompt injection, to send requests to loopback or private addresses or arbitrary external hosts before the browser redirects to about:blank, enabling SSRF and persistent state changes on the target server.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.10.0, a user can add a version under another user's workflow ID and take over its Marketplace listing. An attacker with an account and the target's workflow ID can replace the creator's pending Marketplace submission with their own, so that approval installs the attacker's workflow under the creator's listing. Without reviewer involvement, the attacker can also stop the owner from saving new versions and break runs that name no version. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

A vulnerability was identified in Dispatcharr up to 0.32.0. Affected by this issue is the function get_permissions of the component VODLogoViewSet/M3UAccountViewSet. Such manipulation leads to incorrect authorization. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 0.33.0 can resolve this issue. The name of the patch is ac7a23cc584761b88f8d87dd8ac3688426024ed8. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.11.0, public webhook endpoints woould buffer request bodies in full before verifying them. Anyone with network access to the API ccould exhaust the memory of platform API workers without an account or a valid signature. The chat-bot webhook routes were reachable only where that chat platform was configured. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.63 before 0.11.0, the Office preview expands an embedded ZIP thumbnail without a size limit. A signed-in user with access to workspace file previews can exhaust the memory of a platform API worker with one small crafted DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX file and one preview request. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

A security flaw has been discovered in vanna-ai vanna 2.0.0/2.0.1/2.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function _load_index of the file src/vanna/integrations/faiss/agent_memory.py of the component FAISS AgentMemory Integration. Performing a manipulation results in deserialization. The attack needs to be approached locally. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.3.4 before 0.11.0, LLM and other dynamically priced blocks run without charge when a priced input is left at its schema default. An account with a credit balance of zero can make unlimited language-model, code-generation, and image-generation calls at the operator's expense while the platform records the usage at zero cost. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. A privileged user inside a guest virtual machine could use this flaw to make the host QEMU process copy parts of its own memory into the guest's memory, where the attacker could read it. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to view portions of the host QEMU process memory from within a guest, potentially exposing sensitive information that could aid in further attacks. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to confidentiality.

cves.d: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.11, singleton-scoped ExportService stores the per-request identifiers this.idCsv and this.idZip as BehaviorSubjects and keeps derived directory names in instance fields, while singleton-scoped ImportService stores per-request paths in this._dirname and this._extractPath. Concurrent requests by different tenant administrators to /export, /export/template, /export/filter, or /import can interleave while asynchronous file operations are in progress, allowing one tenant's export archive to be delivered, overwritten, or deleted by another operation, or causing one tenant's import to read another tenant's uploaded CSV data and persist it under the wrong tenant. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.11.

Wails before 2.17.1 on Linux contains an origin validation error in the sendMessageToBackend WebKitGTK handler that allows child-frame scripts to invoke the privileged IPC channel. Attackers controlling content loaded in an iframe can post messages that pass the top-level URI origin check and call bound Go methods and Wails runtime operations.

lightNVR before 0.44.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in go2rtc_proxy_authorize_request() that allows authenticated users to access restricted cameras by exploiting inconsistent src parameter parsing. Attackers can percent-encode a second src parameter name or exceed the 255-byte truncation so go2rtc resolves a different camera, obtaining unauthorized snapshots and HLS live streams.

Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows shared-list collaborators to learn other users' private favourited and archived bookmark state through filter queries. Viewer or editor collaborators can call bookmarks.getBookmarks on a shared list with favourited or archived set to true, inferring owners' private flags from which bookmarks buildCommonFilters returns.

league/commonmark 2.6.0 before 2.10.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability in DelimiterStack::push() that miscounts delimiter runs against the max_delimiters_per_line budget. Attackers submitting Markdown with two long emphasis character runs can produce deeply nested strong elements, causing quadratic rendering time and CPU exhaustion.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in logrotate/force.cgi that prints logrotate -f diagnostic output without HTML escaping. Local OS users can create files with script-laden names in wildcard-rotated log directories, executing script in the Webmin session when Force Log Rotation is clicked.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check_playtime_limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap_login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ldap-client/check.cgi that allows LDAP directory writers to execute commands via unquoted uid values. Attackers can create a posixAccount entry with shell metacharacters in its uid, executing commands as root when an administrator runs Check Configuration.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/edit_user.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup through the LDAP sambaAcctFlags and sambaBadPasswordCount attributes, which are rendered without HTML encoding. Attackers with LDAP write access to these attributes can store malicious scripts that execute in a Webmin administrator's browser when the user entry is opened in the editor.

A flaw was found in the FTP GVfs backend. A malicious FTP server can exploit this vulnerability by providing an arbitrary IP address and port in its passive mode (PASV) response. The client unconditionally trusts this information and attempts to connect to the specified endpoint, allowing the malicious server to probe for open ports accessible from the client's network.

Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in switch_smtp_to_ssl in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl and status/smtp-monitor.pl, which calls Net::SSLeay::connect without certificate verification or a hostname check. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate when SMTP with SSL or STARTTLS is configured to capture SMTP AUTH credentials and message content.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in status/edit_mon.cgi that allows attackers to inject scripts through unescaped monitor status descriptions. Malicious HTTP or FTPS server operators, on-path attackers, or local users creating crafted filenames in wildcard-monitored directories can execute JavaScript in a Webmin user's session.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject scripts by supplying values from managed hosts that cluster modules render unescaped. Attackers who can edit a Servers Index description, control a managed host, or intercept its RPC link can inject server descriptions, versions, user/group names, or package fields to execute JavaScript in the central administrator's session.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows on-path network attackers to inject script by tampering with plaintext HTTP search results rendered unescaped. Attackers who intercept rpmfind.net or Google responses can inject autofocus/onfocus payloads that execute in a logged-in user's browser within the Webmin origin.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in webmin-lib.pl that allows attackers to install unsigned module updates when GnuPG setup fails. Attackers tampering with update downloads via network position or a custom update URL can supply malicious modules that run as root when administrators apply updates.

Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the http_download function of web-lib-funcs.pl that skips TLS chain and hostname verification. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate and substitute downloaded modules, themes, or catalog content, leading to root code execution or injected HTML.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to denial of service.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WP Sunshine Sunshine Photo Cart sunshine-photo-cart allows Code Injection.This issue affects Sunshine Photo Cart: from n/a through 3.8.1.

Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.44.2, getTracker in packages/core/src/lib/throttler/throttler-behind-proxy.guard.ts accepts CF-Connecting-IP without verifying that a trusted Cloudflare edge supplied it; when CF-Connecting-IP is absent, app.set('trust proxy', true) can let an attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-For value determine req.ip. In deployments where a trusted intermediary does not overwrite these headers, or where the firewall permits direct API access, varying the applicable header on repeated POST /auth/login requests gives an unauthenticated remote attacker a distinct throttle bucket for each attempt, so the five-attempts-per-60-seconds limit does not trigger and no account lockout, CAPTCHA, or exponential backoff limits password guessing. This issue is fixed in version 111.44.2.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Dylan Kuhn  Geo Mashup geo-mashup allows Code Injection.This issue affects  Geo Mashup: from n/a through 1.13.24.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insecure Temporary File vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to filesystem access for attacker.

A request smuggling vulnerability exists in libsoup's HTTP/1 header parsing logic. The soup_message_headers_append_common() function in libsoup/soup-message-headers.c unconditionally appends each header value without validating for duplicate or conflicting Content-Length fields. This allows an attacker to send HTTP requests containing multiple Content-Length headers with differing values.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information, unauthorized modification of system resources, and execution of privileged actions that could lead to compromise of the appliance.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Input Validation vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information and privileged functionality.

A flaw was found in the Admin REST API v2 of Keycloak. This component is used by administrators to manage realm configurations, including clients. The issue occurs because the API processes a client update (PUT) request and performs payload validation before verifying if the caller has the required permissions to view or manage that specific client. By sending a request with a mismatched client ID in the body, an authenticated user without any administrative privileges can distinguish between existing and non-existing clients based on whether the server returns a 400 Bad Request or a 403 Forbidden error.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information, unauthorized modification of application data, and execution of actions with elevated privileges within the appliance environment.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to sensitive information exposure and application instability.

PyBioNetGen 0.8.7 contains a code injection vulnerability in ParameterBlock.add_item() and ModelBlock.add_item() that allows attackers to execute Python code by passing parameter expressions to sympy.sympify(). Attackers can supply a crafted BNG-XML model file with Python code in a Parameter expr or value attribute to execute code as the user when loaded with bionetgen.bngmodel().

FCEUX before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in SetBoardName() in src/unif.cpp that allows crafted UNIF ROM files to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .unf file with a 0xFFFFFFFF MAPR chunk length, wrapping the allocation to zero and corrupting heap memory to crash the emulator or execute code.

JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated end users to invoke the internal upd_user_info operation because ImListenerImpl.PublishArrived forwards any client-supplied topic as the RPC method. Attackers holding a valid connect token can supply another user's id to UpdUserInfo to overwrite that user's nickname, portrait, extension fields and settings.

Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability in AMFImporter::ParseFile that overwrites the previous XML parser pointer without releasing it. Attackers can supply repeated AMF files to applications using a long-lived Assimp::Importer to retain parsed documents and exhaust memory.

POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() and InflatingInputStream::reset() that fails to discard unconsumed compressed input after decompression errors. Attackers can supply one corrupt zlib, gzip or zip-deflate stream to applications reusing an InflatingInputStream, causing all later stream reads, including valid ones, to fail.

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the deduplication service (openimis-be-deduplication_py, deduplication/services.py) that allows a caller holding only the narrow right 170001 to bypass column path validation by exploiting the fact that only the first segment of a dotted relation path is checked before the full unvalidated path is used in the query. Attackers can supply a crafted dotted column path such as user_created__i_user__private_key to traverse relations and retrieve an administrator's JWT signing key, enabling forgery of a valid administrator session without a password that survives password resets and generates no failed-login event.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Cool Plugins Language Switcher for Polylang language-switcher-for-divi-polylang allows Code Injection.This issue affects Language Switcher for Polylang: from n/a through 1.1.4.

Author Avatars List/Block plugin for WordPress before 2.2.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to inject arbitrary JavaScript via the card_min_width, card_max_width, card_min_height, and card_max_height attributes of the [authoravatars] shortcode. Attackers can supply a value containing a double quote to break out of the card's style attribute and add event handlers, causing the injected script to execute in the browser of any visitor, including editors or administrators who view the rendered user card.
In Eclipse Jetty, the JSON parsing utilities provided by artifact `jetty-util-ajax` are vulnerable to `StackOverflowError` for inputs that have a large recursive structure.

A flaw was found in nano. In environments with permissive umask settings, a local attacker can exploit incorrect directory permissions (0777 instead of 0700) for the `~/.local` directory. This allows the attacker to inject a malicious `.desktop` launcher, which could lead to unintended actions or information disclosure if the launcher is subsequently processed.

An OS command injection vulnerability in ADM allows an authenticated administrator to create an iSCSI LUN with a crafted name and schedule a snapshot. The scheduler embeds the name in a root cron job without correctly neutralizing shell metacharacters, allowing arbitrary command execution as root when the job runs.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

In Eclipse Che versions 7.61.0 through 7.124.0 three related defects in the SCM-OAuth flow, chain into a Medium-severity finding:



1. Open redirect (CWE-601) — `EmbeddedOAuthAPI.callback()` and the OAuth1 callback issue `307 Temporary Redirect` to whatever URL was carried in the `redirect_after_login` field of the OAuth `state` parameter. The value is fully attacker-controlled and never compared against an allow-list of permitted hosts.



2. Missing CSRF nonce in OAuth `state` (CWE-352) — `OAuthAuthenticator.prepareState()` builds the `state` parameter solely by URL-encoding the original request's query string. No random nonce is bound to the user's session, so an attacker can pre-compute a callback URL carrying _their own_ SCM authorization `code` and have a logged-in victim open it. `callback()` then stores the attacker's SCM token under the victim's Che identity (`personalAccessTokenManager.store(...)`).



3. Mutable field on a `@Singleton` (CWE-362 / CWE-488) — `EmbeddedOAuthAPI` is `@Singleton` but stores the per-request `redirect_after_login` value into the instance field `private String redirectAfterLogin`. Any user's `authenticate()` call overwrites the field for all concurrent users; the `access_denied` error-path of `callback()` then redirects to the _last writer's_ URL.

A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB color mode, the plugin does not properly validate that a fourth channel is present when the transparency flag is set. This mismatch causes the merged-image path to allocate buffers for three components while performing color conversion with four-component formats, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.13, POST /api/integration/github/webhook in packages/plugins/integration-github/src/lib/probot/probot.discovery.ts passes request bodies through ProbotDiscovery.receiveHook to probot.receive without verifying x-hub-signature-256 against the configured webhook secret. Because the route is public and uses the attacker-controlled installation.id to locate integrations, an unauthenticated remote attacker who knows or guesses an installation identifier can forge installation deletion events that remove a tenant's GitHub integration or forge issues events that insert fabricated issue data into the tenant's automation pipeline. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.13.

Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.9, OrganizationPermissionGuard in packages/core/src/lib/shared/guards/organization-permission.guard.ts checks allowManualTime, allowModifyTime, and allowDeleteTime only when the caller's role is EMPLOYEE and unconditionally authorizes other roles. A tenant administrator who grants ALLOW_MANUAL_TIME, ALLOW_MODIFY_TIME, or ALLOW_DELETE_TIME to MANAGER, DATA_ENTRY, VIEWER, or another non-employee role can therefore leave the organization-wide policy disabled while that role still creates, modifies, or deletes time records, undermining payroll and billing integrity. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.9.

A flaw was found in OpenSSH. This vulnerability, a heap out-of-bounds read, occurs during the cleanup of GSSAPI (Generic Security Service Application Programming Interface) indicators when a trailing NULL termination is missing in the auth-indicators array. A remote attacker, under specific configurations involving GSSAPI authentication and a Kerberos environment, could exploit this to cause the SSH authentication path to crash or abort. This leads to a denial of service (DoS), impacting the availability of the SSH service.

A flaw was found in gnutls. The PKCS#7 padding check, performed during decryption, was not constant-time. This timing side-channel could allow a remote attacker to potentially leak sensitive information about the padding bytes through observable timing differences. This vulnerability is a form of information disclosure.

In Eclipse Ditto versions 1.1.0 to 3.9.9, the nginx reverse proxy configurations shipped with Ditto (Helm chart, Docker Compose, Kubernetes and OpenShift deployment files) forward a client-supplied

  `x-ditto-pre-authenticated` header to the Ditto gateway on locations that do not apply nginx authentication, such as `/api/2/connections`. nginx selects the location based on the normalized request URI
  but forwards the raw URI, while the gateway does not treat an encoded slash (`%2f`) as a path separator. A crafted request path is therefore routed by nginx through such an unauthenticated location and
  by the gateway to the regular Things and Policies HTTP API, including routes that send live messages to devices. When pre-authentication is enabled (the default of the Helm chart and the Docker Compose
  setup), an unauthenticated remote attacker can impersonate arbitrary policy subjects and read, modify and delete Things, read Policies, send messages to devices and create entities. Additionally, the
  optional Ingress of the Helm chart (Ditto 3.9.0 to 3.9.9) routes requests directly to the gateway without setting or removing that header, and the WebSocket Ingress of the Helm chart of Ditto 3.3.0 to
  3.8.15 does not set it, allowing the same impersonation without path manipulation when pre-authentication is enabled. This bypasses the fix for CVE-2026-120753.

An improper input validation vulnerability in the OpenVPN client configuration import feature of ADM allows authenticated administrative users to execute arbitrary operating system commands via a crafted .ovpn profile.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

An unauthenticated attacker can send an unsigned SAML single logout request to force users to log out of Grafana Enterprise instances configured for SAML single logout (improper signature verification).

A flaw was found in GIMP. An attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) or potentially disclose sensitive memory contents by convincing a user to open or preview a specially crafted Bohemia Interactive (PAA) texture file. Due to an integer overflow when calculating image dimensions during file decompression, the application allocates an undersized memory buffer. Subsequent processing reads memory past the buffer boundary, terminating the plug-in process unexpectedly.

An injection vulnerability was found in libvirt's virtual network driver. The network XML parser does not strip newline characters from DNS TXT record value attributes and SRV record domain/target attributes. These values are written verbatim into the dnsmasq configuration file generated by the network driver, allowing a user with permission to define virtual networks to inject arbitrary dnsmasq configuration directives such as dhcp-script, leading to arbitrary command execution as root.

cves.d: A flaw was found in the RPM Package Manager (RPM). A local user could be affected by a heap buffer overflow vulnerability when processing a specially crafted NDB database file. This issue arises from an error in how RPM handles certain calculations during file parsing, leading to an incorrect memory allocation. An attacker could leverage this to cause a denial of service, making the system unavailable.

Omnispace Agora Project through 26.11.3 contains a broken access control vulnerability in which the isAutor() function in MdlObject.php grants accessRight=3 based solely on object authorship without verifying the user still belongs to the object's space. Attackers who were previously members and authored objects can retain unauthorized read access to space objects even after being removed from the space, leading to persistent information disclosure.

Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.10, RoleGuard authorizes requests using the role claim embedded in an access token instead of the user's current database role in packages/core/src/lib/core/context/request-context.ts through RequestContext.hasRoles. After an administrator demotes a user, an already-issued token can continue to pass role checks for up to the token's 24-hour default lifetime, including on DELETE /api/tenant and other RolesEnum.SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN guarded routes, which can preserve tenant-destructive and billing privileges after revocation. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.10.

Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge the shared-calendar iCal share token by deriving md5Id() from predictable fields such as object creation time, which is self-disclosed through autorDate and the iCal CREATED field. Attackers can compute the creation minute and forge the md5Id token to access and read a shared calendar's iCal feed without authorization.

Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated general administrators to inject arbitrary SQL by setting the personsSort session value, which is concatenated unsanitized into ORDER BY clauses in MdlUser.php and MdlSpace.php. Attackers can submit an error-based extractvalue payload through personsSort to leak database information, such as the MariaDB version, via the user and space listing pages.

Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious HTML markup by controlling imported directory data or an uploaded CSV file, as values are rendered into table cell text and value attributes after only Txt::utf8Encode() with no HTML escaping in VuePersonsImportExport.php. Attackers can craft a CSV cell containing an attribute-breakout payload that is rendered verbatim and executed in the browser of the administrator performing the import, leading to arbitrary script execution in the administrative context.

Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to access another user's private mail by supplying a crafted reloadMailTypeId parameter to Ctrl::getCurObj() without a readRight() ownership check in CtrlMail.php. Attackers can manipulate the mail identifier value, such as reloadMailTypeId=mail-1, to retrieve the title and body of private messages belonging to other users, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive communications.

Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users to arbitrary external URLs by manipulating the objUrl parameter in Ctrl.php's redir() function. Attackers can craft login links with objUrl set to a malicious site, causing the application to issue an HTTP 302 redirect to that external URL, which can be abused for phishing and credential theft.

A type mismatch vulnerability was found in QEMU's vhost inflight migration VMState handling. The destination buffer size is stored as a uint64_t but read by the VMS_VBUFFER load path as a signed int32_t. On little-endian hosts, a crafted incoming migration state with bit 31 set causes the value to be interpreted as negative and then implicitly converted to a very large size_t, leading qemu_get_buffer() to copy migration-stream data beyond the bounds of the mmap-backed inflight region.

This can result in a crash of the QEMU process or memory corruption. Exploitation requires control of the migration producer or write access to the migration channel, combined with a destination configured to use vhost inflight migration.

cves.d: Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private calendar data by exploiting a missing dateCrea value that causes the md5Id token to collapse to md5(calendarId.userId), both small enumerable integers. Attackers can compute valid tokens and request the misc&action=DisplayIcal endpoint with a forged md5Id to read any user's private calendar events without authentication.

Omnispace Agora Project before 26.11.3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge privileged actions such as administrator user creation by merging $_GET and $_POST parameters without requiring an anti-CSRF token. Attackers can craft a malicious link or auto-navigating page that issues a plain GET request, exploiting the lack of CSRF protection and SameSite=Lax cookie behavior on top-level navigations to create unauthorized administrator accounts.

Mastodon 4.7.4 and 4.8.0-alpha.3 before 5.0.0-beta.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in authenticate_with_sign_in_token that allows authenticated local users to rebind pending login attempts to other accounts. Attackers can submit sign_in_token_resend with a victim's user[email] parameter, then guess the unthrottled 6-character token to sign in as inactive accounts lacking two-factor authentication.

The fix for CVE-2026-55877 (GHSA-6v8j-33hc-mv84) sanitizes the SVG of icons before they are rendered inline. The checks matched attribute names as written in the icon, while browsers and the renderer read some names differently.

On 2.x, fromFile() keys the attributes of the root <svg> element by their local name. A handler like x:onload passed the check, and was then rendered as onload, which runs on load. HTML parsers also read attribute names case-insensitively, so a SMIL animation with ATTRIBUTENAME="href" could set a javascript: URL on a link. And an href in the XLink namespace under another prefix, like q:href, wasn't checked. On 3.x, the sanitizer writes it out as xlink:href, and XML parsers resolve the prefix on both branches.

Applications are exposed when an attacker can influence the SVG of the icons they render. The sources are the same as for CVE-2026-55877, like local icon files and the responses of the Iconify API.

The sanitizer now checks attributes by local name. It also finds the attributeName of animations in any case, and ignores the prefix of its value.

#[AsLiveComponent(route: '...')] makes a live component send its requests to another route. The documentation suggests it so that the component lives under a specific firewall, for example. The default /_components/{_live_component}/{_live_action} route still served the component, though. A request to it rendered the component and ran its actions outside the firewall and the access rules of the configured route.

The request needs props signed by the application, which a page that rendered the component provides. Controller attributes on the component, like #[IsGranted], still applied.

A live component is now only served by the route it is configured with.

WeKan before 12.78 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Exporter.buildStream() that lets attackers retrieve checklists from other boards by supplying a checklistId export scope. Users able to export any board, or unauthenticated users via a public board, can read private checklists, their items and creator usernames even when anonymization is enabled.

The fix for CVE-2026-55877 (GHSA-6v8j-33hc-mv84) sanitizes the SVG of icons before they are rendered inline. Browsers parse an inline

, or . They then parse the rest of the icon as HTML, and they also parse the content of and <desc> elements as HTML. The sanitizer only checked icons as SVG, so an icon could contain markup that becomes live once parsed as HTML. For example, after a <p> element, a comment can end a <style> element early and add an <img> element with an event handler: <p/><style><!--</style><img src=1 onerror=alert(1)>--></style> In the same way, an icon could add a <base> element to the page, which changes where its relative links and forms go. It could also add a <meta> element that redirects the page. Comments were kept too, while browsers end a comment at <!--> or <!--->. The rest of such a comment then became live markup, even without any HTML element before it. Applications are exposed when an attacker can influence the SVG of the icons they render. The sources are the same as for CVE-2026-55877, like local icon files and the responses of the Iconify API. The sanitizer now removes comments and the elements that make browsers switch to HTML, and only keeps the text of <title> and <desc> elements. It also makes sure that markup in CDATA sections and attribute values can't end a <noscript> element around the icon.
