A flaw was found in  mod_proxy_cluster. This vulnerability, a Carriage Return Line Feed (CRLF) injection in the decodeenc() function, allows a remote attacker to bypass input validation. By injecting CRLF sequences into the cluster configuration, an attacker can corrupt the response body of INFO endpoint responses. Exploitation requires network access to the MCMP protocol port, but no authentication is needed.

A flaw was found in util-linux. Improper hostname canonicalization in the `login(1)` utility, when invoked with the `-h` option, can modify the supplied remote hostname before setting `PAM_RHOST`. A remote attacker could exploit this by providing a specially crafted hostname, potentially bypassing host-based Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) access control rules that rely on fully qualified domain names. This could lead to unauthorized access.

The fix for CVE-2026-55877 (GHSA-6v8j-33hc-mv84) sanitizes the SVG of icons before they are rendered inline. It removes scripts and event handlers everywhere, except inside Applications are exposed when an attacker can influence the SVG of the icons they render. The sources are the same as for CVE-2026-55877, like local icon files and the responses of the Iconify API.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in web-lib-funcs.pl and fastrpc.cgi that sends cluster RPC traffic over raw TCP despite SSL configuration. Network-positioned attackers can read the session ID and remote_eval payloads or alter calls in transit to execute code as root on managed servers.

A live component protected by #[IsGranted], on its class or on its default action, can be rendered by a caller who is not granted access. POST /_components/{name}/_batch is handled by Symfony\UX\LiveComponent\Controller\BatchActionController, which has no controller attributes: the attributes of the component are only checked by the sub-request issued for each action. With an empty actions list, no sub-request was issued, and the hydrated component was rendered and returned with a 200.

The caller needs a valid signed props payload for the component, such as the data-live-props-value of a page that rendered it: one the caller could see before losing access, or a cached or shared page. The checksum binds the props to the component name, not to a user, a session or a time, so such a payload can be replayed. Actions are not affected, since each action of a non-empty batch is still checked in its own sub-request. Components that load data from their props, like an entity identifier, disclose that data to the caller.

BatchActionController now rejects a batch without any action with a BadRequestHttpException. The JavaScript client never sends such a request: it uses the URL of the component when there is no action, /{action} for a single one and /_batch for two or more.

A flaw was found in polkit. A local user can exploit this by providing a specially crafted, excessively long input to the `polkit-agent-helper-1` setuid binary via standard input (stdin). This unbounded input can lead to an out-of-memory (OOM) condition, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) for the system.
vp: red hat enterprise linux 10.0 extended update support

cves.d: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing integrity verification vulnerability in usermin/upgrade.cgi that downloads Usermin upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP without signature or digest checks. On-path network attackers or DNS spoofers can supply a malicious RPM, Debian, or tar.gz package whose maintainer scripts or setup.sh execute as root during upgrade.

A flaw was found in Quay. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted, short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT) to achieve privilege escalation. Because Quay improperly accepts scoped registry bearer tokens as valid robot account passwords, an attacker can authenticate directly as the robot account and obtain broader permissions. Consequently, unauthorized access persists and enables the attacker to generate fresh tokens even after the robot account's password has been reset.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/index.cgi that renders MySQL connection error text and server version strings without escaping. Malicious MySQL server operators or on-path attackers on plaintext connections can return markup in error packets or version strings to execute JavaScript in Webmin user sessions.

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the IP block management component of ADM due to insufficient input validation and bounds checking. This vulnerability may allow an authenticated administrator to cause memory corruption, potentially resulting in application crashes or denial of service (DoS).
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the ADM allows remote authenticated administrators to cause a denial of service (service crash) or potentially execute arbitrary code via a crafted tag parameter in settings CGI.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check. Attackers with only pod get permission, including built-in read-only project-viewer, workspace-viewer and cluster-viewer roles, can supply shell metacharacters in the path parameter to execute arbitrary commands inside any viewable container without holding pod exec permission.

When the rsyslog's `imuxsock` is parsing the TAG field from a message with a accepted shorter timestamp, the cursor used to read the message fields and the remaining message length to be read are left in a inconsistent state in relation to the content in the raw message, leading the module to read one byte past the end of the buffer holding the message.

A link-following flaw was found in the authorized_key module of the ansible.posix collection, residual to the fix for CVE-2026-11837. That fix guards only the final path component (os.chown with follow_symlinks=False and O_NOFOLLOW in _safe_open_write()). When an unprivileged local user replaces their ~/.ssh directory with a symlink to a directory they do not own, and an operator subsequently runs the authorized_key task as root (a common provisioning pattern), the module resolves its path operations through the symlink: atomic_move() writes the temporary file in the symlink target and renames it to <target>/authorized_keys, creating or overwriting a file in the attacker-chosen directory, and os.chmod(sshdir, 0o700) follows the symlink and changes the target directory's permissions. The written file is chowned to the unprivileged user, so this is not a privilege escalation, but it allows an attacker to create or overwrite files (for example in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/, which APT reads regardless of file ownership) to cause integrity and availability impacts.

An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in dnsmasq's find_soa() function in src/rfc1035.c. When parsing NS section records, extract_name() is called with extrabytes=0, failing to validate that 10 additional bytes exist for fixed-length DNS record fields. A remote attacker controlling a DNS zone can exploit this via a crafted NXDOMAIN response to cause a 10-byte heap out-of-bounds read, potentially accessing stale data from prior transactions.

SoupAuthManager caches proxy authentication credentials without scoping them to the proxy authority (host:port). When the proxy configuration changes (e.g., via system settings or WPAD), cached Proxy-Authorization headers from the previous proxy are sent to the new proxy, leaking credentials.

A flaw was found in 389 Directory Server in the __aclp__normalize_acltxt() function of aclparse.c. A malformed ACI (Access Control Instruction) string can trigger heap-buffer-overflow writes and reads during ACI parsing. The function fails to validate that the ACI keyword has sufficient length after whitespace stripping, leading to a 1-byte out-of-bounds write and subsequent out-of-bounds reads. An authenticated user with write access to the aci attribute could send a crafted ACI value to silently corrupt heap memory in the directory server process.

A stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server helper of ASUSTOR ADM allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to trigger stack memory corruption by sending a crafted DHCP hostname to a device with DHCP Server enabled. This may disrupt DHCP service.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A potential stack-based buffer overflow exists in ADM Defender Firewall configuration handling. Before the fix, firewall policy processing used string operations without sufficient destination-size checks and did not consistently validate array bounds. Malformed or oversized configuration data may cause an out-of-bounds write and corrupt stack memory.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-client/popup_browser.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup by storing it in LDAP attribute values printed without HTML encoding. Attackers with write access to an LDAP directory entry, needing no Webmin account, can execute scripts in the Webmin origin when an administrator browses that entry.

An OS command injection vulnerability in the PPPoE configuration of ADM allows an authenticated administrator to store shell syntax in the PPPoE account value. When the service loads the resulting configuration, the injected commands can execute with root privileges.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts by submitting malicious failed-login usernames. Attackers can repeatedly submit crafted usernames until blocked, executing script in administrator sessions viewing edit_blocked.cgi in Webmin or Usermin.

An OS command injection vulnerability in ADM allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary commands as root. The set action in settings/ddns.cgi fails to sanitize configuration delimiters in user-supplied parameters before writing them into the DDNS configuration file, allowing an attacker to inject directives that execute arbitrary system commands upon service restart.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

A **NULL pointer dereference** flaw has been found in the acl_check_dns_host_name() and acl_validate_spn_value() functions in source4/dsdb/samdb/ldb_modules/acl.c of the Active Directory domain controller ACL module in the **Samba** package. The checks read the account name after a request that removes it, and they do not test that the value is present. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can update the DNS host name or service principal name of their own computer account can include a removal of sAMAccountName in that same LDAP modify. The directory process crashes. Repeating the modify keeps the directory service unavailable.

KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the CertificateSigningRequest controller that allows attackers with permission to create CertificateSigningRequest objects to escalate privileges by exploiting automatic approval of requests carrying a kubesphere.io/username label without verifying the requester's identity or subject match. Attackers can submit a CertificateSigningRequest for the kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client signer with an arbitrary subject such as a platform administrator to obtain a cluster CA-signed client certificate, enabling authentication as the chosen identity and full cluster administrator privilege escalation.

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting. Any authenticated account, including self-registered or zero-rights users, can exploit this flaw to gain read, write, and delete access to the OpenSearch cluster.

U-Boot versions 2025.04 before 2026.10-rc3 contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in read_slotted_partition() that fails to validate image size against partition bounds. Attackers with physical access can supply crafted boot media with oversized headers to write past the load buffer into bootloader memory on devices without Android Verified Boot protection.

U-Boot versions 2020.10 before 2026.10-rc4 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in sqfs_read_directory_table() function when allocating the directory table buffer. Attackers can supply a crafted SquashFS image with an attacker-controlled superblock metablks_count value that causes heap buffer under-allocation and out-of-bounds writes, corrupting heap memory and crashing the bootloader.

A NULL pointer vulnerability has been found in the the shim application of dp.c library. A missing NULL pointer could allow attackers to perform a denial of service attack on a system that uses shim application for UEFI bootloader.

An integer underflow was found in the popt library when formatting help text for option tables that exceed the terminal width. A local user who can cause an application to print help under those conditions may cause that application to crash or fail to display help, resulting in a denial of service of the affected application.

A flaw was found in QEMU. A specially crafted VMDK image could trigger an out-of-bounds read vulnerability, potentially leading to a 12-byte leak of sensitive information or a denial of service condition (DoS).

A flaw was found in GIMP. Heap-buffer-overflow vulnerability exists in the fread_pascal_string function when processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) file. This occurs because the buffer allocated for a Pascal string is not properly null-terminated, leading to an out-of-bounds read when strlen() is subsequently called. Successfully exploiting this vulnerability can cause the application to crash, resulting in an application level Denial of Service.

HortusFox (hortusfox-web) through 6.4 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in UserModel::restorePassword that builds reset links from the client-controlled Host header. Unauthenticated attackers can request a reset with a forged Host header to capture the victim's reset token and take over accounts including administrators.

An arbitrary file creation and truncation vulnerability exists in the File Explorer of ADM. An authenticated low-privileged user can upload a file with crafted path components containing quote and redirection characters. When music.cgi processes the entry for audio playback operations, the unescaped path string breaks out of the expected argument context in the internal command parser. This causes the system execution helper to open the attacker-specified path with root privileges using O_TRUNC, allowing remote attackers to truncate or create arbitrary system files.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

U-Boot versions 2025.07 before 2026.10-rc5 contain a use-after-free vulnerability in the httpc_recv_cb() function within the lwIP wget implementation. When HTTP data storage fails, the callback frees the connection PCB but returns ERR_BUF instead of ERR_ABRT, causing the TCP input path to access released memory and crash the bootloader.

CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status code vulnerability in ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that reports success when a new file cannot be opened or mapped. Attackers who make an application switch a reused input handler to a nonexistent or empty file cause it to parse the previously loaded file's data as the requested input.

U-Boot versions 2023.07 before 2026.10-rc5 contain out-of-bounds memory access in dhcp6_parse_options() that fails to validate SERVERID and CLIENTID option lengths from DHCPv6 packets. Attackers on the local network can send crafted DHCPv6 ADVERTISE or REPLY packets during netboot to corrupt memory and crash the bootloader.

A format string vulnerability has been reported in the Internal Backup of ADM. User-controlled input from the source_folders parameter is passed by internalbackup.cgi to a shared string-copy routine in libbackup.so.0.0 and used directly as the format-string argument to snprintf() without corresponding variadic arguments. This may allow an authenticated attacker to disclose process memory addresses or trigger unintended memory writes that terminate the affected CGI process.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

Cross Site scripting/injection in SampleAjaxPlugin in Apache JSPWIKI on all versions prior to 3.0.1 on all platforms allows attacker to bypass page encoding, potentially rendering raw html or javascript on the page

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the OAuth authorize endpoint redirects to unvalidated error redirect targets. An attacker can craft a link on the platform's own domain that redirects a signed-in user to an attacker-controlled site, which can present a lookalike consent or sign-in page to harvest credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

Stored XSS/Cross Site Scripting/Injection in the attachment servlet in Apache JSPWIKI on all platforms, all previous versions allows an attacker to upload a malicious HTML file and then potentially have it rendered in browser due to lax rules of rendering inline vs a file download.




Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

Cross Site scripting/injection in ReferringUndefinedPagesPlugin in Apache JSPWIKI on all platforms allows specific fields in the plugin to render unescaped content to the browser.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 which fixes this issue.

A flaw was found in librelp. When using the GnuTLS driver, an improper error handling vulnerability causes the library to terminate the entire host process upon encountering a Transport Layer Security (TLS) record-level error, rather than disconnecting only the affected session. A remote peer capable of establishing a TLS connection can exploit this flaw by sending a corrupted or invalid record, crashing the host application and leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

BusyBox versions 1.27.0 before 1.38.0, fixed in commit 42202bf, contain a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the DHCPv6 client (udhcpc6) DNS_SERVERS option handler in networking/udhcp/d6_dhcpc.c that allows network-adjacent attackers to trigger memory corruption by sending a crafted DHCPv6 response with a malformed D6_OPT_DNS_SERVERS option. Attackers can exploit incorrect heap buffer allocation calculations in the option_to_env() function to cause denial of service or achieve arbitrary code execution on embedded systems without heap hardening.

A flaw was found in foreman-mcp-server. This component utilizes two distinct logging mechanisms that can expose sensitive session and authentication data. One mechanism logs session identifiers, which are treated as authentication credentials, at an informational level. The other, when debug logging is enabled, incompletely sanitizes HTTP request headers, leading to the cleartext logging of sensitive information such as authorization tokens and API keys. This vulnerability can result in a confidentiality breach, as sensitive authentication data is persisted in plain text within container logs, increasing the risk if logs are forwarded to a centralized platform.

A flaw was found in virtio-win. The `RhelDoUnMap()` function does not properly validate the number of descriptors provided by a user during an unmap request. A local user could exploit this input validation vulnerability by supplying an excessive number of descriptors, leading to a buffer overrun. This can cause a system crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

A flaw was found in virtio-win, specifically within the VirtIO Block (BLK) device. When the device undergoes a reset, it fails to properly manage memory, resulting in a use-after-free vulnerability. This issue could allow a local attacker to corrupt system memory, potentially leading to system instability or unexpected behavior.

A flaw was found in foreman. Authenticated users with 'view_keypairs' permission can bypass taxonomy scoping, allowing them to download private SSH (Secure Shell) keys from other organizations by directly querying key pair IDs. This vulnerability leads to cross-tenant data exposure in multi-tenant deployments, potentially compromising sensitive information.

A flaw was found in Foreman. An authenticated user with host-edit permissions could exploit a cross-tenant information disclosure vulnerability. This flaw occurs because the taxonomy_scope controller method does not properly validate organization and location IDs from nested request parameters, bypassing existing authorization checks. This allows the user to leak sensitive infrastructure metadata, including subnet topology, IP ranges, gateways, DNS servers, and VLAN IDs, from organizations and locations they are not authorized to access.

A flaw was found in Foreman. This broken access control vulnerability allows an authenticated user with host-edit permissions to retarget an existing lookup value override to a different host. This is achieved by modifying the match field through nested host attributes, effectively bypassing authorisation checks. The consequence is the potential for unauthorised modification of managed host configurations across different organisational and location boundaries.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated client could exploit an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability in the Authorization Services Protection API endpoint. By knowing or obtaining a resource's unique identifier (UUID) belonging to another Resource Server within the same realm, the client could bypass authorization checks. This allows the client to perform unauthorized GET, PUT, and DELETE operations on resources, leading to information disclosure and potential unauthorized modification or deletion of data.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. A highly privileged user with `manage-clients` permission can exploit this vulnerability by injecting a hardcoded role mapper into any client. This action allows the user to bypass existing scope restrictions and inject the `realm-admin` role into generated tokens, resulting in privilege escalation and full administrative access to the realm.

A flaw was found in DBI. This is a fix for a partial fix for CVE-2026-14380 for RHEL 9.8.z and 10.2.z.

For a detailed Statement, Description and Mitigation please reffer to the original https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-19546.

A flaw was found in Foreman. The Usergroup model in Foreman does not properly validate role assignments against the calling user's permissions. This allows an authenticated user with usergroup management permissions to attach arbitrary roles, including administrative roles, to a user group and then add themselves as a member. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability leads to full privilege escalation, granting the attacker administrator-level access.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated user with the uma_protection role can bypass User-Managed Access (UMA) policy validation. This allows the attacker to include resource identifiers owned by other users in a policy creation request, even if the URL path specifies an attacker-owned resource. Consequently, the attacker gains unauthorized permissions to victim-owned resources, enabling them to obtain a Requesting Party Token (RPT) and access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted POST request with an excessively long scope parameter to the OpenID Connect (OIDC) token endpoint. This leads to high resource consumption and prolonged processing times, ultimately resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) for the Keycloak server.

cves.d: Cockpit's remote login feature passes user-supplied hostnames and usernames from the web interface to the SSH client without validation or sanitization. An attacker with network access to the Cockpit web service can craft a single HTTP request to the login endpoint that injects malicious SSH options or shell commands, achieving code execution on the Cockpit host without valid credentials. The injection occurs during the authentication flow before any credential verification takes place, meaning no login is required to exploit the vulnerability.

red hat enterprise linux 9.6 extended update support

cves.d: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Exposure of Sensitive Information vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to confidentiality impact.

XML::Sig versions before 0.74 for Perl allow code execution via a document's Algorithm attribute that verify resolves to a function name and calls.

The text after the last `#` in the DigestMethod and SignatureMethod Algorithm attributes is looked up with Digest::SHA->can. That returns a code reference for any fully qualified function name, Perl builtins in the CORE namespace included. The digest function is called on the canonical form of the referenced element, so the document picks both the function and its argument.

An attacker who can submit a signed document can run a command as the verifying process.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a CRLF Injection vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to altering application-generated content and affecting system integrity.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access.

A vulnerability was found in libssh, where an uninitialized variable exists under certain conditions in the privatekey_from_file() function. This flaw can be triggered if the file specified by the filename doesn't exist and may lead to possible signing failures or heap corruption.

A denial-of-service vulnerability has been identified in the libsoup HTTP client library. This flaw can be triggered when a libsoup client receives a 401 (Unauthorized) HTTP response containing a specifically crafted domain parameter within the WWW-Authenticate header. Processing this malformed header can lead to a crash of the client application using libsoup. An attacker could exploit this by setting up a malicious HTTP server. If a user's application using the vulnerable libsoup library connects to this malicious server, it could result in a denial-of-service. Successful exploitation requires tricking a user's client application into connecting to the attacker's malicious server.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Lawouach ws4py up to 0.6.0. Affected is the function WebSocketBaseClient.connect of the file ws4py/client/__init__.py of the component Wss Client. The manipulation leads to improper certificate validation. The attack can be initiated remotely. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

The ggml-rpc server suffers from an uninitialized heap memory disclosure vulnerability where the alloc_buffer function provides new clients with buffers containing stale data from previously freed allocations. This allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform an in-bounds read via get_tensor to recover sensitive information, such as model weights or KV-cache data, belonging to other clients sharing the same server.

A flaw was identified in libsoup, a widely used HTTP library in GNOME-based systems. When processing specially crafted HTTP Range headers, the library may improperly validate requested byte ranges. In certain build configurations, this could allow a remote attacker to access portions of server memory beyond the intended response. Exploitation requires a vulnerable configuration and access to a server using the embedded SoupServer component.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to system resources, disclosure of sensitive information, modification of protected configurations, and execution of privileged operations.

A flaw was found in hivex. By supplying a specially crafted Windows registry hive file, an attacker can trigger an out-of-bounds memory read when hivex parses registry values containing malformed large data block lists. This issue can cause the application processing the registry file to crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability. An attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to actions beyond intended permissions.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

In LogicalLink::SignalError of logical_link.cc, there is a possible use after free due to an error callback that can synchronously destroy the link while its channels are still being iterated. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution. This vulnerability is considered critical as it may allow unauthenticated command execution.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains a Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a Denial of service.

Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 are vulnerable to an uncontrolled resource consumption issue in Rex::Proto::Http::Request#normalize!. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send an HTTP request with a deeply nested path that triggers repeated rescans of the request target, causing quadratic CPU consumption and temporarily degrading the availability of any affected HTTP listener.

The issue is fixed in Metasploit Framework 6.5.10

Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this issue by manipulating the DOM environment to execute malicious JavaScript within the context of the victim's browser. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a crafted webpage. Scope is changed.
vp: adobe experience manager as a cloud service

cves.d: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in 10up ElasticPress elasticpress allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects ElasticPress: from n/a through 5.3.5.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in BdThemes ZoloBlocks zoloblocks allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects ZoloBlocks: from n/a through 2.8.4.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in WPManageNinja FluentCart fluent-cart allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects FluentCart: from n/a through 2.3.2.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in WP ManageNinja LLC Fluent CRM fluent-crm allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects Fluent CRM: from n/a through 3.3.1.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in WP ManageNinja LLC WP Social Ninja wp-social-reviews allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects WP Social Ninja: from n/a through 4.5.0.

In HandleRxPdu of channel.cc, there is a possible use after free due to the channel being destroyed while it is still processing a received frame. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

A flaw was found in certmonger. This vulnerability allows a malicious certificate authority or an attacker positioned on an unencrypted network to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending oversized or deliberately slow responses. Certmonger fails to enforce size limits or transfer timeouts when downloading and buffering Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) replies over HTTP. Consequently, an attacker can exhaust host memory, drive CPU usage to capacity, or cause certificate requests to hang indefinitely.

A vulnerability was found in libsoup's HTTP/2 protocol implementation. The library fails to correctly release memory context blocks under specific stream termination conditions, such as when an HTTP/2 connection encounters window exhaustion or explicit stream resets. A remote, unauthenticated attacker acting as a malicious network peer can trick the connection engine into allocating stream states that are subsequently leaked during cleanup. Over a sustained period, this flaw allows the remote attacker to consume the system's heap allocations incrementally, triggering a denial of service (DoS) through an ultimate Out-of-Memory (OOM) application crash.

A heap buffer over-read vulnerability was discovered in libsoup's (versions: libsoup 3.0 to 3.7.0) HTTP/2 connection tracking framework. When the library processes an HTTP/2 GOAWAY frame, it improperly handles the "Additional Debug Data" payload by assuming the data stream is a safely NUL-terminated C-string. Because the parser lacks strict length-boundary verification before reading this data, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can intentionally send a malformed GOAWAY frame missing the appropriate null delimiter. This causes the library to read past the end of the allocated buffer, triggering an application crash that results in a denial of service (DoS), or potentially exposing fragments of memory contents.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in BdThemes Ultimate Post Kit ultimate-post-kit allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Ultimate Post Kit: from n/a through 4.6.2.

A flaw was found in 389 Directory Server. The PBKDF2-SHA256 password verification function uses standard memcmp() for comparing password hashes instead of a constant-time comparison function. A remote attacker could potentially use timing measurements of LDAP bind attempts to infer partial hash information, though practical exploitation is extremely difficult due to PBKDF2 computational overhead.

A logic vulnerability was found in GStreamer's webrtcbin component. The _check_sdp_crypto() function contains an inverted boolean condition that causes it to accept remote SDP offers or answers that lack the required a=fingerprint attribute, while incorrectly rejecting those that include it. An attacker with the ability to intercept and modify WebRTC signaling messages could exploit this to bypass the SDP-level DTLS certificate fingerprint binding, weakening defenses against man-in-the-middle attacks on media streams.

Two off-by-one errors in the FreeIPA ipa-otpd daemon's OAuth2 device authorization handler can cause out-of-bounds memory access when processing an oversized response from a configured external OAuth2/OIDC Identity Provider. An attacker who controls or can man-in-the-middle the IdP endpoint may be able to trigger ipa-otpd to write or read one byte past the end of a fixed-size buffer. Exploitation requires FreeIPA to be configured with an external IdP, attacker control or MITM of that IdP, and a user to initiate the OAuth2 device authorization flow. The most likely impact is limited denial of service affecting the ipa-otpd daemon.

A flaw was found in Glib's content type parsing logic. This buffer underflow vulnerability occurs because the length of a header line is stored in a signed integer, which can lead to integer wraparound for very large inputs. This results in pointer underflow and out-of-bounds memory access. Exploitation requires a local user to install or process a specially crafted treemagic file, which can lead to local denial of service or application instability.

A flaw was found in popt. This vulnerability allows an attacker to provide specially crafted configuration content to a host, which, when loaded, can lead to a small memory corruption issue. This occurs because of an error in how the `poptConfigFileToString` function reallocates memory for buffers. Successful exploitation could result in heap metadata corruption, potentially causing the affected process to become unavailable (denial of service).

A flaw was found in popt, a command-line option parsing library. An off-by-one error in the poptStuffArgs function, when repeatedly called by a host application or through deep alias nesting, can lead to corruption of internal program data. This corruption could potentially enable a local attacker to execute arbitrary code if the host application then unsafely processes the altered data.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow') vulnerability. A high privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to remote execution.

A flaw was found in dhcp-server. A remote attacker with network access to the OMAPI (Open Management Application Programming Interface) port, especially if not secured with TSIG (Transaction Signature) key authentication, could send a specially crafted lease creation request. This request, containing an overly long InfiniBand MAC address, triggers a buffer overflow in the `print_hw_addr()` function. Successful exploitation leads to a persistent denial of service (DoS), causing the `dhcpd` service to crash and preventing it from restarting without manual intervention.

A flaw was found in gdk-pixbuf. This vulnerability allows a remote attacker to cause a heap out-of-bounds read by providing a specially crafted Apple Icon Image (.icns) file. The uncompress() function, which handles RLE-encoded ICNS icon data, fails to validate the source buffer's boundaries during decompression. This can lead to a denial of service, where the application crashes, or to information disclosure, potentially revealing sensitive data from adjacent memory.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in David Lingren Media LIbrary Assistant media-library-assistant allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Media LIbrary Assistant: from n/a through 3.43.

A flaw was found in libarchive. An attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) or potential information disclosure due to a use-after-free vulnerability, which occurs when a program reads memory that has already been released. This issue arises when the archive_entry_copy_mac_metadata() function deallocates an internal buffer before completing a data copy. An attacker who can supply input to an application utilizing this function can trigger the flaw to crash the application or read uninitialized memory data.

A flaw was found in GStreamer's gst-plugins-good. A heap-based out-of-bounds read of 4 bytes can occur when parsing FLAC audio stream headers embedded in a Matroska or WebM container file. The vulnerability is triggered by a boundary check that does not account for the full size of the data being copied, allowing a small read past the end of the allocated buffer. An attacker could exploit this by crafting a malicious Matroska or WebM file and tricking a user into opening it, potentially leaking a small amount of adjacent heap memory.

A flaw was found in pki-core. The certificate authority (CA) renewal request path does not perform the realm-based authorization check that the enrollment path performs, allowing an authenticated user entitled to one realm to cause a certificate belonging to a different realm to be renewed without that realm's authorization.

A signed integer overflow vulnerability was found in libarchive's ZIP writer. In the archive_write_zip_header function in archive_write_set_format_zip.c, when ZIP encryption is enabled and the entry file size is close to INT64_MAX, the addition of the encryption overhead to the entry size overflows int64_t, resulting in undefined behavior. This could lead to incorrect Zip64 extension decisions or potential memory corruption.

A vulnerability was found in the internal Access Control List (ACL) subsystem of kronosnet (Version affected: <= 1.34). When the framework is explicitly configured to manage dynamic links (accepting network traffic from any IP address) without network payload encryption, the validation architecture implicitly trusts the link ID provided within incoming data packets. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this lack of validation by spoofing a legitimate link ID inside crafted network frames. This allows the attacker to fully bypass the ACL framework and inject arbitrary data packets into the application layer, potentially leading to data corruption or service instabilities.

A vulnerability was found in kronosnet's (version <=1.34) cryptographic configuration management. The framework does not correctly zero-out or wipe sensitive memory segments after executing changes to its cryptographic configuration. This omission leaves raw encryption keys resident in memory after the associated structures are freed. A local attacker capable of leveraging memory disclosure techniques could exploit this flaw to retrieve the active encryption key, allowing them to decrypt cluster network communications or inject malicious packets to cause severe high-availability cluster instability.

A flaw was found in libsoup, an HTTP client/server library. This HTTP Request Smuggling vulnerability arises from non-RFC-compliant parsing in the soup_filter_input_stream_read_line() logic, where libsoup accepts malformed chunk headers, such as lone line feed (LF) characters instead of the required carriage return and line feed (CRLF). A remote attacker can exploit this without authentication or user interaction by sending specially crafted chunked requests. This allows libsoup to parse and process multiple HTTP requests from a single network message, potentially leading to information disclosure.

cves.d: A stack buffer overflow flaw was found in 389 Directory Server. The checkPrefix() function in pw.c copies an attacker-controlled algorithm ID into a 256-byte stack buffer without bounds checking when parsing reversible-encrypted attribute values. An attacker with Directory Manager privileges can crash the LDAP server by storing a crafted credential with an oversized algorithm ID. FORTIFY_SOURCE mitigates this to denial of service only.

A heap buffer overflow flaw was found in 389 Directory Server. When audit logging is enabled, the create_masked_entry_string() function in auditlog.c copies a fixed-length password mask into a precisely-sized heap buffer without checking available space. If a short cleartext password is logged (requiring non-default CLEAR password storage or a compromised replication peer), the copy overflows the buffer, corrupting heap memory and audit log output.

A flaw was found in 389 Directory Server. The LDIF parser reads past the end of a heap buffer when processing attribute types with trailing semicolons during database import, causing an out-of-bounds read detectable under memory instrumentation.

A flaw was found in libslirp. When handling ICMP echo requests, the reply length is not updated to match the actual data received from the host. Under specific conditions where the normal ICMP socket is unavailable, this length mismatch causes the host's real IP address to be leaked to the guest in the echo reply, breaking the NAT isolation that user-mode networking is expected to provide.

This could allow an attacker to access files in a sibling directory if that directorys name starts with the same characters as an authorized safe directory.

A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by presenting a specially crafted certificate chain to an application that uses glib-networking with the GnuTLS backend enabled and performs certificate verification. This crafted chain, which contains circular issuer relationships, can cause an infinite loop during certificate verification. The unbounded traversal consumes excessive CPU resources, leading to a denial of service for the affected process or worker.

A flaw was identified in the RelaxNG parser of libxml2 related to how external schema inclusions are handled. The parser does not enforce a limit on inclusion depth when resolving nested <include> directives. Specially crafted or overly complex schemas can cause excessive recursion during parsing. This can cause application crashes, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

This missing null check can lead to reading beyond allocated memory on the heap. This can cause unexpected behavior or lead to a denial of service (DoS) due to application crashes.

cves.d: A flaw was found in kubevirt Containerized Data Importer (CDI). The CDI clone controller derives the CommonName of a CDI-CA-signed upload client certificate from the tenant-settable cdi.kubevirt.io/uploadClientName PVC annotation without validation, and the upload server authenticates clients only by certificate CA chain and CommonName string match, with no namespace or PVC binding. A namespace user can obtain a valid client certificate and write arbitrary data into any upload-ready PVC in any namespace whose upload Service is reachable from the cluster network, resulting in cross-namespace integrity impact on disk images used by virtual machines.

A vulnerability was found in the netavark package, a network stack for containers used with Podman. Due to dns.podman search domain being removed, netavark may return external servers if a valid A/AAAA record is sent as a response. When creating a container with a given name, this name will be used as the hostname for the container itself, as the podman's search domain is not added anymore the container is using the host's resolv.conf, and the DNS resolver will try to look into the search domains contained on it. If one of the domains contain a name with the same hostname as the running container, the connection will forward to unexpected external servers.

A flaw was found in libssh's handling of key exchange (KEX) processes when a client repeatedly sends incorrect KEX guesses. The library fails to free memory during these rekey operations, which can gradually exhaust system memory. This issue can lead to crashes on the client side, particularly when using libgcrypt, which impacts application stability and availability.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, the MCPToolBlock auto-lookup allows a shared agent's author to use the MCP credentials of the user who runs it. Anyone who ran a shared agent containing an MCPToolBlock node, and had already connected the MCP server URL that the node names, had that connection used for any read, write, or delete the server exposes, with the result sent to a host chosen by the author. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

A flaw was found in rsyslog. When using the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) output module (omdtls) configured to authenticate receivers by name or fingerprint, the module validates the certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities but fails to verify that the certificate matches the intended receiver's identity or fingerprint. An attacker who can redirect or intercept outbound network traffic and present a certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority could capture forwarded log data, leading to information disclosure.

A flaw was found in m17n-lib. A partial failure during library initialization can leave an internal driver pointer uninitialized. Under specific error conditions, such as system resource exhaustion or database corruption, an application attempting to open an input method dereferences this null pointer without proper validation. This issue causes the application to crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

A flaw was found in BlueZ. An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the btmon Bluetooth monitor tool when processing crafted HCI Return Link Keys events. A maliciously crafted btsnoop capture file can specify a large number of link keys that exceeds the actual packet data, causing btmon to read beyond the allocated buffer and crash.

An argument injection flaw was found in CUPS. When email notification is configured, the CUPS scheduler accepts printer subscription requests that supply a mailto notify-recipient-uri. The mailto notifier passes the recipient address to the configured sendmail program without ensuring it cannot be interpreted as command-line options. A remote attacker who can reach the CUPS service could supply a crafted recipient value starting with "-" to influence sendmail behavior. Successful exploitation depends on the installed mail transfer agent and CUPS network exposure, and may lead to execution of attacker-controlled commands with the privileges of the CUPS service user.

A flaw was found in SSSD. A local attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted request to the autofs responder UNIX socket. Due to improper buffer offset calculation during request parsing, the service performs an out-of-bounds memory read. This flaw can cause the autofs responder process to crash, resulting in a denial of service (DoS).

Webmin through 2.670 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in password_change.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to change passwords for accounts with empty stored hashes. When passwd_mode is 2, attackers can POST user, old, new1 and new2 with any old value to set a known password and gain access.

In Phase2SecureConnections::OnPeerPublicKey of phase_2_secure_connections.cc, there is a possible way to learn the passkey used during pairing due to an incomplete check for a reflected public key. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is needed for exploitation.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Brainstorm Force SureForms sureforms allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects SureForms: from n/a through 2.14.1.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WP User Manager WP User Manager wp-user-manager allows Code Injection.This issue affects WP User Manager: from n/a through 2.10.6.
A flaw was found in GLib. A denial of service on Windows platforms may occur if an application attempts to spawn a program using long command lines.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in WP ManageNinja LLC Fluent Support fluent-support allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects Fluent Support: from n/a through 2.5.0.

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module (openimis-be-api_fhir_r4_py) that allows an authenticated attacker with limited district-level access to receive subscription notifications for data outside their authorized scope due to the absence of row-level security checks such as has_perms, get_queryset, ROW_SECURITY, district, or health-facility scoping on the notification delivery path. Attackers can register a standing FHIR subscription to continuously receive claim data and can further direct notification pushes to internal network addresses.

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.

CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in ly_out_reset() in src/out.c that tests a stale errno ESPIPE value after a successful seek. Applications reusing one output handler for different clients rewind but do not truncate the file, leaking leftover bytes of a previous client's output.

libyang through 6.4.13 contains a file descriptor leak in ly_in_new_filepath() and ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that fails to close descriptors when file mapping fails. Attackers who can supply files parsed through lyd_parse_data_path() or lys_parse_path() can repeatedly submit empty files to exhaust descriptors, causing later file and socket operations to fail.

POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() that fails to clear stale buffered data from a previous failed stream. Attackers can supply one corrupt compressed stream to an application reusing an InflatingOutputStream, causing subsequent valid streams to fail decompression.

Boost.JSON 1.75.0 through 1.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in monotonic_resource::release() because it does not reset next_size_ when returning blocks upstream. Attackers can send repeated JSON documents larger than the initial block, growing allocation sizes geometrically until every later allocation fails with bad_alloc.

JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to invoke the internal g_del_members operation by supplying it as a client topic. Attackers holding a valid connect token can send crafted WebSocket or HTTP publish requests with arbitrary group and member ids to remove any users from any group in the application.

HortusFox through 6.4 contains an information exposure vulnerability in BackupModule::start that allows unauthenticated attackers to download workspace backups stored in the public/backup directory. Attackers can enumerate one-second-precision creation timestamps used as filenames to retrieve archives containing locations, plants, gallery, tasks, inventory and calendar data.

FCEUX 2.5.0 before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in iNESLoad() in src/ines.cpp that allows a crafted NES 2.0 ROM to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .nes file using exponent-multiplier PRG ROM size notation with mappers 53, 198, 228 or 547 to corrupt memory, crashing the emulator and possibly executing code.

OneDev before 17.2.4 contains an argument injection vulnerability in commit query handling that allows authenticated attackers to inject git options through branch or tag names. Attackers can push a branch named like --output=<path> and query it via the commits page or REST API to overwrite server-writable files, causing denial of service.

asar-py before 0.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in AsarArchive.extract() and extract_archive() that allows attackers to write files outside the destination directory via crafted archive headers. Attackers can supply a .asar archive with '..' path components or malicious symlink targets to write files such as usercustomize.py, leading to code execution.

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the report module (openimis-be-report_py) where the /api/report/reportbro/preview endpoint evaluates printIf expressions server-side using simpleeval with an insufficient name-prefix blocklist. An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JWT signing keys.

Docker Sandboxes reuses existing state and configuration directories without verifying their ownership. If sbx or sandboxd is run as root with HOME or, on Linux, XDG_STATE_HOME pointing to an attacker-controlled location, a local unprivileged user can substitute control-plane sockets and configuration trusted by the root process, potentially executing commands as root. Exploitation requires a privileged invocation with an attacker-influenced environment. The issue affects Linux and macOS and is fixed in version 0.53.0.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Andy Moyle Church Admin church-admin allows Code Injection.This issue affects Church Admin: from n/a through 5.1.14.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in John-Michael L'Allier Create mediavine-create allows Code Injection.This issue affects Create: from n/a through 3.1.4.

An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information, modification of protected resources, and execution of privileged operations within the appliance security context, potentially resulting in compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Exposure of File Descriptor to Unintended Control Sphere ('File Descriptor Leak') vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Race Condition vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized modification of data or service disruption.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a TOCTOU Race Condition vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to limited integrity impact and service instability.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Uninitialized Variable vulnerability. A local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure or denial of service.

A flaw was found in OpenSSL's handling of the properties argument in certain functions. This vulnerability can allow use-after-free exploitation, which may result in undefined behavior or incorrect property parsing, leading to OpenSSL treating the input as an empty string.
A flaw was found in GLib. An integer overflow and buffer under-read occur when parsing a long invalid ISO 8601 timestamp with the g_date_time_new_from_iso8601() function.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Out-of-bounds Write vulnerability. A local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to application instability, denial of service, disclosure of sensitive information, arbitrary memory modification, and potentially execution of attacker-controlled code within the affected process.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Brainstorm Force CartFlows cartflows allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects CartFlows: from n/a through 3.3.3.

A path traversal vulnerability in Flatpak's handling of the files/etc directory during app deployment allows a malicious Flatpak app to cause certain host system files (such as passwd, group, machine-id, or resolv.conf) to be emptied or replaced with a symlink when the app is installed or upgraded. cves.d: AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains a division by zero vulnerability in asc_read_translation_status() in compose/asc-utils-l10n.c that allows attackers to crash compose runs via crafted Qt .qm files. Attackers can supply a valid .qm file with no TRANSLATION records, triggering SIGFPE that terminates the entire appstreamcli compose or libappstream-compose process.

Obtainium before 1.7.5 trusts the allowIdChange field in imported app data, allowing attackers to bypass the package ID mismatch check by delivering crafted obtainium://app deep links. Once a victim confirms the import, attackers can silently replace a tracked app with an attacker-controlled source and install a different APK, prompt-free when Shizuku or root is authorized.

A weakness has been identified in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT up to 0.8.2. This impacts the function skill_upload of the file packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/agentic_data_api.py of the component Skill Upload Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument filename can lead to path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.8.3 will fix this issue. This patch is called fc6a5017d5a8509d34700694bbd8a637bde311fb. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. This is a regression of CVE-2026-51862 because the fix shipped in 0.8.1 was reverted in 0.8.2 and the corrected code exists only on the unreleased main branch.

Remote Mouse for macOS before 3.511 contains a URL scheme validation bypass vulnerability in the opn sub-command of the web command handler, SystemCommandHandler::performWebPanelRemoteFunction_, which checks only for the presence of http:// or https:// substrings rather than validating the actual URL scheme before passing input to NSWorkspace.openURL. Attackers who can reach the TCP command service on port 1978 can send a crafted file:// URL containing a decoy http:// substring to launch arbitrary local applications, open local files with their default handlers, or invoke other applications' registered URL schemes as the logged-in user, requiring no authentication unless a connection password is configured.

ntop n2n supernode 3.0 through 3.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to leak memory and execute code by sending an untrusted 16-bit auth token_size in REGISTER_SUPER_NAK datagrams. Attackers can register an edge in a chosen community, then send an oversized token_size to leak stack canaries and pointers, overwrite the return address, or crash the supernode.

A security flaw has been discovered in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. The affected element is an unknown function of the file include/sqlite3.inc of the component Web Management Interface. Performing a manipulation results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw was found in the exsltFuncResultComp() function of libxslt, which handles EXSLT <func:result> elements during stylesheet parsing. Due to improper type handling, the function may treat an XML document node as a regular XML element node, resulting in a type confusion. This can cause unexpected memory reads and potential crashes. While difficult to exploit, the flaw could lead to application instability or denial of service.

A vulnerability was identified in GongShengyue OnlineBooks up to dfc5eacc08d3b0396c266049548618f6fb9587ea. This vulnerability affects the function insert of the file src/cn/ylcto/book/filter/AdminLoginFilter.java of the component BooksServlet. The manipulation leads to missing authorization. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product follows a rolling release approach for continuous delivery, so version details for affected or updated releases are not provided. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw was found in QEMU, in the virtio-scsi, virtio-blk, and virtio-crypto devices. The size for virtqueue_push as set in virtio_scsi_complete_req / virtio_blk_req_complete / virito_crypto_req_complete could be larger than the true size of the data which has been sent to guest. Once virtqueue_push() finally calls dma_memory_unmap to ummap the in_iov, it may call the address_space_write function to write back the data. Some uninitialized data may exist in the bounce.buffer, leading to an information leak.

cves.d: CubeWP Forms before 1.1.13 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript by submitting unregistered field names through the public REST route cubewp-custom-form/v1/submit/, which bypasses its own nonce check and saves unsanitized values due to a missing default case in the sanitizer, later rendered unescaped on the admin Leads detail page. AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.1 through 0.10.0, credentials are sent to a third party when a redirect's Location header hides the new host behind a backslash. A signed-in user who connects an MCP server URL, or runs a shared or marketplace workflow with a host-scoped credential, can have that credential delivered to a third party if the host responds with a redirect whose Location the other party influenced. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

A vulnerability was found in zhblue hustoj up to 26.08.19. Affected is the function prepare_files of the file trunk/core/judge_client/judge_client.cc. The manipulation results in os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 26.10.31 is able to address this issue. The patch is identified as 07c73e1434c4c8e49094396c7d93bb09d6f159a4. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP Media WP Rocket wp-rocket allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Rocket: from n/a before 3.23.5.

A flaw has been found in mealie-recipes Mealie up to 3.29.0. Affected is the function get of the file mealie/pkgs/i18n/provider_factory.py of the component I18n Locale Provider. Executing a manipulation of the argument Accept-Language can lead to path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 3.30.0 is able to address this issue. This patch is called 4d074185d0dd1bb2dada7a4470bd04bd91227040. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

This impacts the function _shard_files of the file FlashInfer/rkv/loader.py of the component FlashInfer weight loader. This manipulation of the argument weight_map causes path traversal. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.11.0, template rendering is not bounded in size or time. Any signed-up user who can reach a block that takes a format string, such as Fill Text Template or Agent Output, through POST /api/blocks/{id}/execute or the external API's block-execute route, can make the REST API process allocate without bound with one request of a few dozen bytes. This can stop the process from answering any request, including its health check. There is no data read or change impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

A flaw was found in libssh. This vulnerability allows local man-in-the-middle attacks, security downgrades of SSH (Secure Shell) connections, and manipulation of trusted host information, posing a significant risk to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of SSH communications via an insecure default configuration on Windows systems where the library automatically loads configuration files from the C:\etc directory, which can be created and modified by unprivileged local users.

Multiple uses of uninitialized variables were found in libopensc that may lead to information disclosure or application crash. An attack requires a crafted USB device or smart card that would present the system with specially crafted responses to the APDUs

A flaw has been found in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. The impacted element is the function store of the file modules/Permissions/Http/Controllers/RolesController.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to dynamically-determined object attributes. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. This patch is called 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is best practice to apply a patch to resolve this issue.

A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-bad mxfdemux handling of MXF Index Table Segment data. Crafted index metadata can lead to an out-of-range lookup during a seek and terminate the media process. A Fedora 43 test reproduced an assertion-triggered abort. The upstream advisory also notes possible information disclosure, but an attacker-visible leak has not been demonstrated.

OpenProject 17.2.0 before 17.5.2, 17.6.0 before 17.6.1, 17.7.0 before 17.7.3, 17.8.0 before 17.8.2, and 17.9.0 before 17.9.7 contains an externally controlled method selection vulnerability in InplaceEditFieldsController via the unvalidated attribute parameter. Users who can view a project can request the inplace_edit_fields reset route with attribute destroy to delete projects and subprojects, or invoke other methods exposing restricted data.

A flaw was found in NetworkManager. When a system running NetworkManager with DEBUG logs enabled and an interface eth1 configured with LLDP enabled, a malicious user could inject a malformed LLDP packet. NetworkManager would crash, leading to a denial of service.
A flaw was found in the cockpit package. This flaw allows an authenticated user to kill any process when enabling the pam_env's user_readenv option, which leads to a denial of service (DoS) attack.

SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a reachable assertion in RTCP decoding that lets remote WebRTC peers crash the server. Attackers opening an unauthenticated WHIP or WHEP session can send an 8-byte RTCP packet with undersized length, triggering srs_assert aborts that stop every stream.

A vulnerability was found in GNU Nano that allows a possible privilege escalation through an insecure temporary file. If Nano is killed while editing, a file it saves to an emergency file with the permissions of the running user provides a window of opportunity for attackers to escalate privileges through a malicious symlink.
In mutt and neomutt, PGP encryption does not use the --hidden-recipient mode which may leak the Bcc email header field by inferring from the recipients info.

In mutt and neomutt the In-Reply-To email header field is not protected by cryptographic signing which allows an attacker to reuse an unencrypted but signed email message to impersonate the original sender.

A out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.2, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.8, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.13, FortiOS 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or command via crafted packets.

TypesenseVectorStore is vulnerable to a document ID injection in its delete operation that can cause unintended documents to be deleted.



 TypesenseVectorStore.doDelete(List<String>) builds a Typesense filter_by expression by raw string concatenation of caller-supplied document IDs into the form id: [id1,id2,...] . The Typesense id field uses bare (unquoted) values in this list form with no escaping mechanism. An ID containing characters with syntactic meaning in the Typesense filter grammar — such as a comma ( , ), a closing bracket ( ] ), or operator tokens ( || , && ) — can break out of the list literal and alter the structure of the filter expression.



 An attacker who controls a document ID passed to the delete operation can use this to delete documents other than the intended ones (comma injection), or to construct a filter that matches every document in the collection (operator breakout), resulting in unintended bulk deletion.



 Applications that pass externally supplied or user-controlled document IDs to VectorStore.delete(List<String>) backed by TypesenseVectorStore are affected.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to server-side request forgery.

WeKan before 12.78 contains an access control bypass in Exporter.buildCsvStream() that ignores the Disable all export and Anonymize export users settings. Board readers or unauthenticated users of public boards can request the CSV export endpoint to export all cards and reveal real usernames in member, assignee, and mention fields.

Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability in ManualList.mergeInto that allows list owners to retain collaborator bookmarks by merging shared lists without ownership checks. Owners invoking the lists.merge tRPC procedure create rows not tied to collaborator membership, preserving read access to collaborator bookmarks and assets after the collaborator's access is revoked.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Download of Code Without Integrity Check vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

Improper validation of a BSON array length in the MongoDB Go Driver can cause an out-of-bounds index and runtime panic when an application calls bson.RawArray.Validate or bsoncore.Array.Validate on a malformed four-byte array. An unauthenticated actor who can supply raw BSON array data to an affected application may terminate an unprotected application process, causing a denial of service. No confidentiality or integrity impact has been identified.

An integer overflow in BSON value-length handling in the MongoDB Go Driver can cause a runtime panic when an application validates or accesses a malformed BSON document. An unauthenticated actor who can supply BSON bytes to an affected application may terminate an unprotected application process, causing a denial of service. The driver's server-monitoring path contains panic recovery and is limited to server-selection failure.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access.

Improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic in the GridFS component of the MongoDB Go Driver can cause a caller-supplied structured file identifier to be interpreted as a query condition rather than as a literal identifier. An authenticated user who can influence the identifier passed by an affected application may cause all GridFS file chunks in the affected bucket to be removed, rendering stored file content unreadable.

The MongoDB Go Driver's client-level bulk write operation may accept a caller-supplied database name containing a reserved separator character without escaping it before the name is used to build the target namespace for the operation. An application that passes untrusted input as a database name could therefore have the write directed at a database and collection other than the ones it intended. Only the Client.BulkWrite API is affected.

A flaw was found in xdgmime. A heap-based buffer overflow can be triggered in _xdg_mime_magic_parse_magic_line() in the xdgmimemagic.c file on little-endian systems when an attacker-controlled MIME magic file in a user-writable XDG data location (e.g., in the $XDG_DATA_HOME/mime/magic path) is parsed by an application performing MIME type detection (e.g., via g_content_type_guess()). When performing byte-swap, incorrect pointer arithmetic on the write side causes an out-of-bounds write of 2 bytes, resulting in an application crash or memory corruption.

cves.d: The use-after-free vulnerability was found in the AuthentIC driver in OpenSC packages, occuring in the card enrolment process using pkcs15-init when a user or administrator enrols or modifies cards. An attacker must have physical access to the computer system and requires a crafted USB device or smart card to present the system with specially crafted responses to the APDUs, which are considered high complexity and low severity. This manipulation can allow for compromised card management operations during enrolment.

A flaw was found in the Linux kernel's memory deduplication mechanism. The max page sharing of Kernel Samepage Merging (KSM), added in Linux kernel version 4.4.0-96.119, can create a side channel. When the attacker and the victim share the same host and the default setting of KSM is "max page sharing=256", it is possible for the attacker to time the unmap to merge with the victim's page. The unmapping time depends on whether it merges with the victim's page and additional physical pages are created beyond the KSM's "max page share". Through these operations, the attacker can leak the victim's page.
